content: Kyber Desktop 0.27.0 is a GitLab superproject at commit 6c75cc276e40ed9cca4e9dcabe3f7e4e1d83c44f. It pins winit 73cc8880 and kysdk 5836202a; kysdk pins kyctl e46dda28, kymedia e80eb6bb, kymux 831d3120, kynput 5595478f, and kyutil 5704c85d. kyclient is the winit application, kycontroller orchestrates subprocesses, kyavservice/txproto own media capture and encode, kyclient/kyvlcplayer own playback, and build-macos.sh can package an arm64 app.
